name: How long does smoke damage restoration on walls take?

mainEntity.name: How long does smoke damage restoration on walls take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of smoke damage restoration on walls depends on the severity and scope of the damage. For minor smoke residue in a single room, the cleaning process might take a day or two. However, for significant fire damage involving multiple rooms, extensive soot removal, structural cleaning, deodorization, and potential repairs, the process can extend from several days to a few weeks. Factors like the drying time for cleaning agents or primers also influence the timeline. A detailed assessment from restoration specialists will provide a more precise project duration estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration time ranges from a day for minor damage to several weeks for extensive fire damage, depending on severity and scope.
